candidates.title: RoboWM-Bench: A Benchmark for Evaluating World Models in Robotic Manipulation
candidates.why_candidate: moves world-model evaluation from visual plausibility to embodiment-grounded action executability for robotic manipulation

candidates.title: VLA-Arena: An Open-Source Framework for Benchmarking Vision-Language-Action Models
candidates.why_candidate: separates VLA capability-frontier measurement into orthogonal structure/language/visual axes instead of collapsing everything into one aggregate success rate

candidates.title: Colosseum V2: Benchmarking Generalization for Vision Language Action Models
candidates.why_candidate: pushes VLA evaluation beyond nominal zero-shot perception into controlled perturbation-based generalization measurement with simulation-to-real correlation checks

candidates.title: MiraBench: Evaluating Action-Conditioned Reliability in Robotic World Models
candidates.why_candidate: defines action-conditioned reliability as a first-class target rather than assuming image fidelity stands in for robotic faithfulness

candidates.title: iWorld-Bench: A Benchmark for Interactive World Models with a Unified Action Generation Framework
candidates.why_candidate: turns interactive world-model evaluation into a multi-input, action-space-unified benchmark instead of model-specific camera-control demos

candidates.title: WBench: A Comprehensive Multi-turn Benchmark for Interactive Video World Model Evaluation
candidates.why_candidate: brings multi-turn interaction and heterogeneous control-interface unification into one benchmark rather than one-step or single-axis evaluation

candidates.title: WorldMark: A Unified Benchmark Suite for Interactive Video World Models
candidates.why_candidate: creates the first common playing field for interactive image-to-video world models with standardized scenes, controls, and reusable evaluation toolkit

candidates.title: WorldOlympiad: Can Your World Model Survive a Triathlon?
candidates.why_candidate: unifies physical, geometric, and interaction diagnostics across robotics, gaming, and open-domain world-model scenarios rather than isolating one dimension

candidates.title: WorldBench: Disambiguating Physics for Diagnostic Evaluation of World Models
candidates.why_candidate: disentangles physical concepts into more diagnostic tests instead of entangled holistic video-quality proxies

candidates.title: MIND: Benchmarking Memory Consistency and Action Control in World Models
candidates.why_candidate: Open-domain memory/action benchmark with public project page and code.

candidates.title: PhyGround: Benchmarking Physical Reasoning in Generative World Models
candidates.why_candidate: Strong official physical-reasoning benchmark with public project page and judge model release.
